text: Quick decisions on waiting ideas: options as proposal children, clickable links in status comments
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: the agent stuffed long text into status comments when an idea waited on Felix: draft messages, Gmail draft references, file paths, 'DECISION: (a)/(b)/(c)'. The inbox shows it as one blob; the human can't click the draft or pick an option.

Felix 2026-11-23: loves the goal (work through human-dependent ideas quickly, decide fast) but doesn't want extra data for one specific state. Shape agreed instead, using what exists:
(1) Options as child ideas: the agent adds each choice as a child of the waiting idea with status ai-proposition, its description saying what the choice leads to. Deciding = accepting one (it turns open, becomes the next work) and cancelling the others. The review inbox shows a waiting idea with its proposal children as buttons.
(2) Links in status comments, for every status: URLs and file paths render clickable, so a prepared draft or file is one click away. Display only, no new data.
The hook/MCP guidance tells agents to prepare decisions this way.

Refuted if Felix still ends up reading long comments to decide.

status.comment: Accepted by Felix 2026-11-23 in this shape (no new field).
